title: ShopLite high latency and 5xx spike — P99 > 2950ms, error rate 41%
description: ShopLite is returning HTTP 500 errors on 41% of requests to /products and /orders. P99 latency has spiked to 2950ms (threshold 2000ms). Pods are running and healthy (no OOM). FAULT=latency is active. No database issues detected.
